name: german_credit
title: German credit data (24 standardized numeric predictors)
description: UCI Statlog German credit (german.data-numeric), 1000 customers. 24 numeric predictors standardized to mean 0, variance 1 (population SD). y = 1 good credit risk, 0 bad. As used in Hoffman & Gelman (2014), Sec. 4.1.2.
